question: Sardar Sarovar Dam was constructed in Gujarat over the __________ .
solution:
The correct answer is " **Narmada river** ".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sardar Sarovar Dam was constructed in the village of **Kevadiya in Gujarat.**
 
• It was developed over the** Narmada river**.
 
• The dam was inaugurated in** 2017 **by the prime minister of India.
 
• The dam was constructed to **provide water and electricity** to four Indian states: **Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, and Rajasthan**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** Bhakra Nangal dam** is built across the **Sutlej river** in Punjab.
 
• There are approx. **24 dams and projects **built on river **Ganga.**
 
• The **Hirakund dam** is built across the **Mahanadi river**.
